description: Chief Minister Nitish Kumar-led government has formulated a new policy called ‘Bihar State Bridge Management and Maintenance Policy, 2025’ to enhance safety and efficiency of state-maintained bridges.
body_lead: Bihar will use AI to ensure pothole-free roads, safe bridges: Minister Nitin Navin Chief Minister Nitish Kumar-led government has formulated a new policy called ‘Bihar State Bridge Management and Maintenance Policy, 2025’ to enhance safety and efficiency of state-maintained bridges.
